solo.expect: Solo: the planner fixes it itself and spawns no teammates.

full.prompt: /agent-team:team Add expense splitting (splitExpense and shareOf, spec section Splitting) and the formatPeso display helper (spec section Formatting).
full.expect: Full or Pair+: pm criteria, tech-lead plan, engineers on separate files, qa evidence, report with model table; hidden tests pass; spec untouched.

gate.prompt: /agent-team:team Add refunds as described in the spec section Refunds. Run it with a team (Pair at least), not Solo: I want the engineer and QA roles exercised.
gate.expect: Pair or Full (explicitly requested). The gate's JSDoc rule refuses the engineer's first finish; the engineer fixes it and the gate passes.

worktree.prompt: /agent-team:team Add refunds (spec section Refunds) and expense categories with totalsByCategory (spec section Categories and totals). Use the full team with one engineer per feature, even though both touch src/ledger.js.
worktree.expect: Worktree mode (on in team.md): engineers work on team/<name> branches in their own worktrees; the planner merges and removes them.

parked.prompt: /agent-team:team Add multi-currency support so expenses can be recorded in USD or JPY.
parked.expect: The pm flags it as parked; the planner stops and asks the user; no code changes and no engineers.
